title: Collodion Process scene
prompt:
À partir de cette photo de référence d’un homme souriant sur une plage, avec des lunettes de soleil, une barbe courte et un t-shirt blanc, recréer le même portrait comme s’il avait été réalisé avec un procédé photographique au collodion humide sur plaque.

title: Cyberpunk cat poster
prompt: Cat looking at the sun and ‘on top of the world, cyberpunk poster, in the style of Erik Jones, social media portraiture, sparth, vibrant color fields, graffiti and street art, highly detailed figures, hyper-detailed

variants.prompt:
Create a bold cyberpunk poster-style image expressing calm triumph and scale.
VISUAL DESCRIPTION
A solitary cat standing on the edge of a futuristic megacity rooftop, gazing into a massive glowing artificial sun on the horizon.
The city below is dense, abstracted, and futuristic, filled with neon towers and layered urban forms.
STYLE
Cyberpunk poster illustration with strong street-art and sci-fi concept art influence.
Bold graphic shapes mixed with painterly textures, graffiti marks, and mural-like composition.
COLOR & LIGHTING
Vibrant neon color fields — magenta, cyan, acid yellow, deep indigo.
Extreme backlighting from the sun, glowing rim light around the cat, high contrast, luminous haze.
COMPOSITION
Low-angle heroic view.
Centered subject with a clean, powerful silhouette.
Designed to read instantly as a poster.
DETAILING
Hyper-detailed fur and face on the cat.
Highly detailed figure against a slightly abstracted city background for clarity.
TONE / STORY
Quiet victory.
“On top of the world” expressed visually, not literally.
OUTPUT
Vertical poster format, ultra-detailed, high-resolution, graphic yet cinematic.
variants.label: Variante (libellé Gemini, non vérifié)

variants.prompt:
A lone cat stands on the edge of a towering futuristic megacity rooftop at dawn.
The city stretches endlessly below, dense with glowing neon towers and holographic signage.
Ahead, an enormous artificial sun rises on the horizon, flooding the skyline with radiant light.
The cat looks upward, calm and confident — a quiet sense of triumph, as if it has reached the top of the world.
The visual style blends cyberpunk futurism with street-art energy: bold color fields, painterly textures, and graphic mural aesthetics inspired by sci-fi concept art and contemporary graffiti.
Vibrant neon magenta, cyan, acid yellow, and deep indigo dominate the palette.
Cinematography
Low-angle heroic framing, emphasizing scale and dominance
Slow, deliberate camera push-in toward the cat
Subtle parallax in the city layers below
Lighting & Atmosphere
Intense backlighting from the rising sun
Strong glowing rim light outlining the cat
Volumetric haze, light bloom, and soft lens flare
Floating dust and atmospheric particles catching the light
Motion
The cat’s fur gently moves in the wind
Neon lights flicker softly across the city
Holograms pulse faintly in the background
Mood
Epic, contemplative, victorious — quiet power rather than aggression.
A cinematic poster moment brought to life.
variants.label: Variante (libellé SORA, non vérifié)
